gloss: scale; graduation; markings on a measuring instrument

definitions.explanation: The divisions or markings on a measuring instrument such as a ruler, thermometer, or measuring cup that indicate measurement values.

examples.japanese: {目盛|めも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{温度計|おんどけい}→温度計：25699_ondokei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目盛|めも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三十度|さんじゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}している→指す：02056_sasu⟧。
examples.english: The thermometer's scale shows thirty degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計量|けいりょう}カップ→計量カップ：25021_keiryoukappu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目盛|めも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I added water to match the markings on the measuring cup.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) and ⟦{盛|も}り→盛り：13696_mori⟧ (mark, division). Refers specifically to the graduated lines or marks on measuring instruments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目盛|めも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the scale)
- {目盛|めも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to align with the markings)
- {目盛|めも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ (the scale is fine/detailed)
- {目盛|めも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to have markings/be graduated)

Not to be confused with ⟦メモリ→メモリ：04893_memori⟧ (memory, as in computer memory), which is a loanword from English.
